caption: The drawing features a woman standing and facing forward. She has light skin, black hair styled with a center part, and red lips. She is wearing a short red cape with a pink and black repeating pattern over her shoulders, which is lined with a purple border and beige lace at the edges. Beneath the cape, she has a green top. Around her neck, she wears a gold necklace and a white lace high collar. Her skirt is full and reaches the ankles, decorated with two distinct sections: the left side features a multicolored floral pattern with pink, green, red, and white, while the right side is tan with a white and brown floral lace pattern. The skirt is further embellished with wide gold fringe, which forms V-shapes across the waist and near the hem. She is wearing black shoes, and her hands hang at her sides. The background of the image is plain and off-white. The signature "Edith Tamm" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Hattie"
